name: Refactor Rendering with RenderBuffer
summary: Create a `RenderBuffer` class to encapsulate row budgeting and rendering logic for TUI components.

rawActions.name: Define RenderBuffer Ctor and Props
rawActions.summary: Define the constructor (injecting IView and initial row budget) and private properties (remainingRows, rows) for the RenderBuffer class to ensure context-aware row budgeting.

rawActions.name: Define pushHeader API
rawActions.summary: Adds a header row to the buffer, consuming 1 unit of the budget.

rawActions.name: Define pushCollection API
rawActions.summary: Iterates through a collection and adds items to the buffer, handling ellipsis reservation and budget exhaustion.

rawActions.name: Define pushRow API
rawActions.summary: Adds a single row to the buffer if there is enough remaining budget.

rawActions.name: Define getRenderData API
rawActions.summary: Returns the accumulated array of RenderRows from the buffer.

rawActions.name: Refactor Task.renderDataAtZeno
rawActions.summary: Replace manual row budgeting in Task.renderDataAtZeno with RenderBuffer pushRow/pushCollection/getRenderData.

rawReferences.name: Implementation Location
rawReferences.summary: Proposed location for the new RenderBuffer class.
